page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9t.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance designed for high-performance computing and GPU-accelerated workloads. It is equipped with 192 dedicated Intel Xeon 8575C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system features 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates eight G59 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 256 GB of video RAM. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 170 Gbps. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key architectural tradeoff of the ecs.ebmgn9t.48xlarge is the absence of local storage, as the local storage size is specified as None. This requires reliance on external network-attached storage solutions. Given the dense configuration of 192 dedicated vCPUs, 1.5 TB of system memory, and eight hardware accelerators, this server is designed for large-scale parallel processing tasks. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, complex AI inference, high-performance computing simulations, and massive data parallel processing jobs.

Running on the KVM hypervisor, the server has no local storage, requiring external storage solutions. This resource-dense profile is optimized for demanding workloads such as large-scale machine learning, deep learning training, and high-performance computing simulations that require massive parallel processing capabilities and high memory capacity.
